title: Secure >= 1 external adopter + record adoption evidence
context: External adoption is required for the curriculum to meet its M3 success metric (>= 1 confirmed external adopter that teaches or embeds the material independently). This is distinct from the authors running a workshop: it requires a named third party who uses the curriculum autonomously. Adoption evidence must be verifiable (a syllabus reference, a scheduled run, a taught fork) and recorded in the outcome ledger. Once an adopter is confirmed, that adopter's tasks are updated to verifiedNeed: true with requestor set. Depends on: trainer-018 (the kit that makes independent adoption possible) and cohort-017 (proof the curriculum has been taught).
objective: Secure >= 1 named external adopter that teaches or embeds the curriculum independently, record adoption evidence in the outcome ledger with a verifiable external reference, and update relevant task fields to verifiedNeed: true with requestor set.
acceptanceCriteria: A named third party (institution, core facility, graduate program, or Carpentries instructor) confirms they will teach or embed the curriculum: evidenced by a syllabus reference, scheduled workshop/event record, or taught fork with a verifiable link.
Adoption evidence committed to the outcome ledger (outcomes/<event-id>.json) with: adopter name/org, verifiable link/record, date, format (workshop/course/embedded), and scope.
Relevant tasks updated to verifiedNeed: true and requestor set to the named adopter, where applicable.
If the adopter is a Carpentries instructor, carpentries-024 (port to Carpentries Incubator) is flagged as a related next step.
Outcome ledger entry committed with DCO sign-off; reviewed and signed off by Steward.
resources: PLAN.md (Success metrics — adoption; Governance — Steward role)
cohort-017 (first taught cohort — evidence of teachability)
output: Outcome ledger entry (outcomes/<event-id>.json) recording the named external adopter with verifiable evidence; updated task fields (verifiedNeed: true, requestor set) for relevant tasks; Steward sign-off.
